layout: - Phase 4 moved the Solitaire table into solitaireplus/games/solitaire/screen.py (handle_event/draw for PLAYING, DRAWS_LATE; update_solitaire_round() = the per-frame Head-to-Head opponent progress and round completion, called from legacy.loop_post_event_updates) and Head-to-Head into solitaireplus/games/solitaire/head_to_head_screen.py (start_head_to_head_event, finish_head_to_head_race, restore_head_to_head_game_settings). The rules engine is solitaireplus/games/solitaire/rules.py (the Game class; was game.py), Head-to-Head logic games/solitaire/head_to_head.py, race deals race_deals.py. The Career hub screen is still in solitaireplus/legacy.py (loop_event_career_hub / loop_draw_career_hub; it moves in Phase 5). The recap screen is solitaireplus/profile/recap.py.

tasks.prompt: Fix B1 (auto-solve stops early): Game's auto-solve (solitaireplus/games/solitaire/rules.py, around the auto-solve stepping every 140 ms) gives up when a stock move is blocked by the 220 ms stock flip animation (click_stock does nothing while the flip animates). When a stock move is blocked by the animation, auto-solve must wait and try again instead of giving up. Test: a deal that needs a stock recycle completes under auto-solve (drive Game headless with a controlled clock: patch pygame.time.get_ticks).

Fix B2 (Restart after a race deal restores the wrong deal): Game.new_race_game() calls new_game(), which captures the random deal for Restart before the race layout is swapped in. Capture the restart snapshot after the race layout is set. Test: after new_race_game(...), the restart snapshot equals the race deal (and Restart reproduces it).

Fix B3 (the Head-to-Head countdown counts against the player): the player's race timer starts at deal time (games/solitaire/rules.py and games/solitaire/head_to_head.py), so the 3-2-1 countdown is added to the player's time. Start the player's timer when the countdown ends. Test: the player's elapsed race time at the end of the countdown is 0 (controlled clock).

Fix B4 (invisible Career Solitaire hotspot): career_play_rect is handled in the Career hub's click handler (solitaireplus/legacy.py loop_event_career_hub) but never drawn; it sits over calendar row 0 and opens Career Solitaire with no pending activity (wins pay without using a day), and because it is a plain if, the jobs/real-estate/news/back checks also run on the same click. Remove the hotspot and its handler, and the duplicate career_play_rect definition (there are two assignments). Keep the other hub buttons working exactly as before. Test: a click in that area of the hub does not change state to PLAYING (and does not start a career round); the other hub buttons still work.

Fix B5 ('Leave table? -> No' deals a new paid game): in the Recap screen (solitaireplus/profile/recap.py handle_event) the No answer, after the pending career activity was already cleared at round completion, deals a fresh career game whose wins later pay full career rewards without using a day. Designer decision (Dan, 2026-11-15): 'No' returns to the Career hub without dealing a paid game. Make sure nothing reward-eligible is left set. Test: after 'No' the state is the Career hub, no game was dealt for a career reward, and the reward-eligible flags/pending activity are not set.

Fix B6 (abandoning a career round leaves stale state): the pause menu's 'Yes, return to menu' path in the Solitaire screen (solitaireplus/games/solitaire/screen.py handle_event) leaves pending_career_activity_* set and the game's challenge active. Clear the pending career activity variables and call game.clear_challenge() there. Test: both are cleared after abandoning.

Fix B8 (Head-to-Head opponent keeps racing while in Options): the Head-to-Head opponent progress uses wall-clock time, so while the player is in the pause -> Options screen the opponent keeps advancing (see update_solitaire_round in solitaireplus/games/solitaire/screen.py and games/solitaire/head_to_head.py). Pause the opponent while the state is not PLAYING (account for time away so the opponent resumes where it was). Test: time spent in Options does not advance the opponent (controlled clock).

D1 (part): delete the Solitaire debug hotkeys from the Solitaire screen's event handler (solitaireplus/games/solitaire/screen.py handle_event): F8 (instant win: sets game.round_won, a fixed round_summary, plays celebration_1 and starts the debug victory animation) and F7 (game.debug_auto_solve_state()). Do NOT delete the code they call (Game.start_debug_victory_animation, Game.debug_auto_solve_state): in Phase 10 the F10 menu gets a 'Win this Solitaire round' button that runs the old F8 code, so move the F8 body into a function in the Solitaire screen module named instant_win_round() (unused for now) instead of deleting it. Test: pressing F8 or F7 in PLAYING no longer changes the game (round_won stays False); instant_win_round() exists and does what F8 did.
